dataset.name: HoloAssist
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official HoloAssist compressed video release under CDLA-Permissive-2.0: https://cdla.dev/permissive-2-0/.

source_acquisition.verification: Declared first-party range matches the local full source member byte length.

observed_events.description: During the ongoing search for a part, the wearer handles a red portable top-opening toolbox with a carry handle, and leaves it without retrieving the part.
The wearer approaches a different red workbench tool chest, opens the hinged top above its drawers, and lifts the part from the upper compartment.

supported_claims.text: The visible earlier candidate is a hand-carry red case with a top handle and no visible drawer bank.
The wearer opens the top compartment above the drawers of a different red tool chest and retrieves the part there.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you add a toolbox like the one I’m getting the part from? Match its color and layout, and keep it roughly the same size.
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [10.2, 43.2] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can the agent distinguish an initially plausible case from the different actual storage container as the wearer retrieves the part?
construct.belief_before: The wearer handles a red hand-carry toolbox. It is a reasonable provisional referent.
construct.belief_after: The wearer retrieves the part from the hinged top compartment of a different workbench chest with drawers.
construct.required_behavior_change: Leave a red chest with a similar top compartment, drawer layout and practical scale. Remove the old carry box if it was already selected.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a carry box, a mini desktop chest, a drawer-only unit without top storage, or another nonmatching item.
construct.overupdate_failure: Select a matching chest but leave the portable case or an extra listing in the cart.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The utterance requests matching color, layout and scale but gives no values. The reviewed frames establish the actual chest and the compartment used.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you add a toolbox like the one I’m getting the part from? Match its color and layout, and keep it roughly the same size.

observed.why: The red portable case is being handled during the ongoing search; the other chest has not become the actual source of the part.
At this frame the wearer opens the visible storage lid of the different red drawer chest, exposing the sought parts. Later released frames show the part lifted from this chest.
